name: Silgan Plastics Corporation
old_description: Silgan Plastics specializes in two-step preforms, the cornerstone of high-quality plastic containers. Through meticulous injection molding, heating, stretching, and blowing processes, we create versatile preforms that cater to diverse packaging needs. Our expertise ensures consistent outcomes, reflecting our commitment to precision and innovation.
about:
Silgan Plastics Corporation operates from Flora, Illinois. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not disclosed in public materials. It focuses on plastic packaging manufacturing.

The company produces plastic bottles, jars, containers, closures, and two-step preforms using injection molding, heating, stretching, and blow molding processes. It maintains multiple Commercial Development Centers across North America staffed with product engineers and molding technology. Its catalog includes over 30 automotive mold-available items and more than 800 other mold-available choices.

Silgan serves industries including automotive (motor oil and automotive bottles), personal care, healthcare, food and beverage, household, industrial chemicals, agriculture, home care, over-the-counter health, pet care, spirits, and wipes. Customers range from brands seeking custom packaging to those using stock or mold-available designs.

The company emphasizes rapid-to-market, cost-effective innovation, supported by in-house decoration, design, and engineering services. It also highlights sustainability practices across its production process, from manufacturing to shipping.
